name: atlas08_cg_legs
description: Where can the CG sit? Sweep the CG x offset of ATLAS_08 and the leg length on a takeoff-hover-land cycle: hover headroom, pitch trim and touchdown behaviour. Grid search.
objective: phases.hover.util_max + 0.02 * abs(phases.hover.pitch_mean_deg) + 0.1 * (metrics.touchdown_speed if metrics.touchdown_speed is not None else 5)
